description.value: Paul's Omelettery is a beloved South Granville breakfast and brunch institution that has been serving comfort food since 2000, earning a loyal following for its crepe-style omelettes, lumberjack pancakes, and eggs Benedict. Owned and run by Dino Arsens, the restaurant occupies a chic yet relaxed space with bench seating and a wood bar, and is steps from Granville Island — a natural stop on Vancouver's seawall cycling corridor. Menu highlights include B.C. free-run egg omelettes, huevos rancheros, and house corned beef hash.
